params.notes: the card itself becomes an action space that only its owner may use
each use hands the owner one begging marker (a negative scoring token)
on the 1st/2nd/3rd/4th use of this space the owner gains 6/7/8/9 goods of mutually different types, chosen by the owner; 5th and later uses are not covered by either source

effects[1].steps[1].params: no count source or predicate expresses 'how many times this space has been used this game', so the 6/7/8/9 distinct-goods table keyed by use count is provisional; 'different goods' (別種) is read as mutually different types per the English row 'different good of your choice'

review.notes: Cost: none. Prereq: none. Printed points: 0. Ban: none. Own-word summary of the third-party wiki effect: the card becomes an action space usable only by its owner; on the 1st/2nd/3rd/4th use the owner receives 1 begging marker and 6/7/8/9 goods of mutually different types of their choice. Classification (docs/all-cards-classification-final.md, PR #377 source): stage 4, P9 own private space plus use count, TR-SITE / STACK / DEC; MQ-13 (5th-and-later use behavior) is an open question with a provisional default only. Sources: BGA wiki JA page and English list row, cross-checked; not official Lookout verification.
